resources.string: Choose a topic. Lessons show the controls without saving changes or sending anything.
Choose the local time for reminders here. Android may deliver them later. This guide leaves the schedule unchanged.
Choose a preset or individual weekdays. This schedule also applies to repeats. At least one day is required.
This section is open for the guide. Its switch is unchanged: thresholds and repeats take effect only after enabling and saving.
Set the distance and days before the yellow level here. The red level has the same fields below. Zero means notifying when that level is reached. Card colours stay unchanged.
The interval is in days; the notification count limits repeats at one level. Zero means unlimited. The red level has separate settings.
This guide has saved nothing. After finishing, edit the fields and tap Save. A service item or document can have its own schedule in its editor.
Use the summary for a general question. Full history adds service and refuelling records. This guide leaves the current selection unchanged.
The question appears at the start of the text alongside the car data. It can be left blank. No typing is required during this guide.
This switch hides the VIN and car name. Free-text notes may still contain personal details, so review the text before sharing.
Next prepares the text on this device using the current options. Car records stay unchanged and nothing is sent.
This is the exact text that will be copied or saved. After the guide, scroll through and check it. The back arrow returns to the options and question.
After the guide, copy the text, share it with another app or save a file. Large exports use a file. This guide never presses these buttons.
On Android 13 and later, choose the app language here. Earlier versions use the phone language. This does not change the country, units or currency.
The country determines available documents and the automatic currency. Existing records stay intact. Documents are added only with the separate button.
Units affect distance, fuel and consumption display and input. Saved mileage and service intervals are not reset. The choice is independent of the country.
This row shows the currency and how it is chosen. Next opens the list to show automatic and manual selection without changing the setting.
This option uses the selected country’s currency and follows country changes. Choose a country first if none is set. The guide does not select this option.
Search by currency code or name. A manual choice stays when the country changes. Existing amounts are not converted using exchange rates. After the guide, tap a row to apply a choice.
